newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Martin County, Fla..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Martin County, Fla..

text.p: Sealed or faxed bids will be received by the Acting County Administrator on behalf of Martin County, Florida (the County''), in the Budget Office, located on the 3rd Floor of the County Administration Building, 2401 S.E. Monterey Road, Stuart, Florida 34996, until 11:00 A.M., Eastern time on
for the purchase of all but not less than all, and for a price not less than 99% of the par value thereof, of $7,700,000 Martin County, Florida General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997 (the

by Resolution No. 96-5.18, adopted on May 28, 1996, issued in fully-registered book-entry only form, dated May 1, 1997; with semiannual interest payable February 1 and August 1 of each year, beginning August 1, 1997. The Bonds will be in the
denomination of $5,000 each or integral multiples thereof, redeemable as provided in the Official Notice of Sale, and will mature on August 1 in the years and amounts as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds are general obligations of the County secured by a pledge of the full faith, credit and taxing power of the County. In the Resolution, the County has covenanted to levy ad valorem taxes on all non-exempt real and personal property located within the boundaries of the County without limit as to amount or rate at a rate sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on the Bonds when due in each year. See the Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds for a further description of the security for the Bonds. The Bonds will be issued to reimburse the County for moneys advanced (together with interest thereto) to purchase land in the County known as the FIT Property and

improvements thereon for educational, recreational, cultural and other public purposes. The County shall furnish at its expense within 7 business days after the Bonds have been awarded to the successful bidder, and in sufficient time to accompany any confirmation of the successful bidder that requests payment from any

customer, sufficient copies of the final Official Stat to comply with applicable SEC and MSRB rules. The successful bidder will be furnished the legal opinion of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey L.L.P. at the expense of the County. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement deemed final'' (except permitted omissions) by the County in accordance with SEC Rule 15c2-12, Official Notice of Sale, Official Bid Form, and other information may be obtained from William R. Hough & Co., Financial Advisor to the County: (561) 691-5333, Attention: Judy Roulis or (407) 422- 5161, Attention: John White.
